role: Interface exposing a boss's max health, current health and display name to the client boss bar; implemented by EntityDragon and EntityWither.

members.name: getMaxHealth
members.note: the dragon's 200 maxHealth is baked into dragon_setup; the wither's 300 is switched off (world.conf wither = off)

members.name: getHealth
members.note: dragon_state.health, maintained by dragon_tick and dragon_attack_part

members.name: func_145748_c_
members.note: the boss display name has no native counterpart; it only feeds the client boss bar (BossStatus), which is client_cosmetic and unported

notes: The interface itself needs no code; these members are realized on the dragon side (dragon_state.health and the 200 maxHealth). EntityWither also implements this interface but the wither is switched off (world.conf wither = off), so only the dragon side exists natively. The interface is read client-side only through BossStatus.setBossStatus (RenderDragon.doRender). Not verified: nothing beyond what these notes state. The dragon's getHealth/getMaxHealth and func_145748_c_ ("Ender Dragon" plus the formatted text's reset) reach BossStatus through raster_mobs_draw's raster_hud_boss_set; the recordings carry hp, mhp and the Java name (test_hudscreens).
